account_closed: This account is closed: no activity can start living on it, and nothing is declared on it afterward.
transfer_has_no_category: An internal transfer has no category.
not_an_advance: The selected movement is not an advance.
financing_settled: This financing is already paid off.
not_a_financing: Only a financing has a written schedule.
schedule_empty: A financing keeps at least one installment: close it rather than emptying its plan.
installment_not_found: An installment of this plan no longer exists: reopen the panel to start from the current plan.
installment_repeated: The same installment appears twice in the plan.
no_gap: This balance check has no gap to settle.
actor_exists: This name already refers to an existing counterparty.
bad_source: The source account or counterparty is missing.
bad_target: The destination account or counterparty is missing.
no_owned_account: A movement must involve at least one of your accounts.
refunded_movement: A refund is linked to this movement: delete the refund first.
account_exists: An account already has this name.
card_exists: A card already has this name.
card_needs_payment_account: A card debits a current account, not a savings or investment account.
schedule_on_immediate: An immediate debit card has no cut-off day and no debit day.
deferred_needs_schedule: A deferred debit card needs its cut-off day and its debit day.
bad_card_day: A day of the month runs from 1 to 31 (31 for the end of the month).
bad_card_shift: This weekend shift does not exist.
card_in_use: Movements, subscriptions or financings go through this card: it stays, and its account can no longer change.
card_other_account: This card debits an account other than the one chosen.
card_expired: The card had expired on that date. If it was renewed, update its expiry.
transfer_has_no_card: A transfer between your accounts does not go through a card.
refund_has_no_card: The refund of an advance lands on the account, never on the card.
card_needs_expense: Only an outgoing subscription or a financing can be paid by card.
statement_debit_ahead: This day has not come yet: a statement is confirmed once the bank has debited it.
statement_debit_before_cut_off: A statement cannot be debited before its cut-off.
account_has_operations: This account holds investment operations: its type can no longer change. Everything else can be edited.
opening_needs_its_day: Enter the opening day: this balance counts from that day on.
actor_has_no_activity: Attach an activity to this counterparty first.
category_exists: A category already has this name.
activity_exists: An activity already has this name.
activity_closed: This activity is closed on that date.
activity_regime_fixed: This activity has rules or invoices: its regime cannot change. Close it and create the next one.
activity_has_accounts: This activity lives on accounts: remove them from its details first.
activity_not_business: Only a business activity lives on accounts and has invoices, rules and thresholds.
vat_rate_needs_registration: A VAT rate requires a VAT-registered activity.
activity_closes_before_start: The closing date comes before the activity starts.
jurisdiction_not_found: This jurisdiction is no longer in the catalog: go back to the first step.
regime_model_not_found: This regime is no longer in the catalog: start the questionnaire again.
regime_answer_unknown: An answer matches none of the options: start the questionnaire again.
regime_answers_incomplete: A question was left unanswered: start the questionnaire again.
regime_model_excluded: Your answers rule out this regime: start the questionnaire again.
bad_rate: A rate is a percentage between 0 and 100.
check_not_found: This balance check no longer exists.
check_already_settled: An adjustment already settles this balance check.
financing_has_no_lock_in: A financing ends with its last installment: no end date.
alias_taken: This name already refers to a counterparty: merge them rather than adding this alias.
merge_self: A counterparty cannot be merged with itself.
advance_needs_amount: Enter the share you expect back.
advance_amount_invalid: The expected share must be greater than zero.
advance_amount_too_large: The expected share cannot exceed the expense amount.
advance_is_expense: Only an expense can be advanced for someone.
advance_has_refund: A refund is already linked to this advance: delete it before removing the amount owed to you.
advance_below_refunds: What has been refunded already exceeds the expected share.
advance_settled: This advance is already fully refunded.
transfer_stays_eur: A transfer between your accounts is declared in euros.
transfer_has_no_accrual: An internal transfer counts in no period total: no accrual.
transfer_has_no_vat: An internal transfer has no VAT.
vat_outside_amount: VAT is included in the amount: it cannot exceed it.
vat_needs_registered_activity: Only an expense of a VAT-registered business activity carries deductible VAT.
needless_eur_amount: The amount is already in euros: no euro equivalent applies.
no_exchange_rate: No exchange rate is known for this currency on that date. Check the code, or enter the euros debited.
bad_currency: A currency is a three-letter ISO code other than EUR.
financing_keeps_currency: A financing’s schedule is written in its currency: close it and declare the new plan.
not_an_investment_account: Only an investment account holds operations. Funding this account is a transfer.
asset_is_quoted: This asset takes its price from its source: a price entered by hand would duplicate it.
asset_has_operations: This asset has operations: they make up the account’s history. Delete them first, or keep it.
oversold: You are selling more than this account holds. Check the quantity, and the account.
needs_quantity: Enter the quantity bought, as the broker shows it: only the execution price can tell it.
same_account: A contribution goes from one account to another: these two are the same.
placement_has_no_actor: A scheduled contribution pays no one: no counterparty, no category, no commitment end date.
not_a_placement: Only a scheduled contribution funds an investment account and buys an asset.
asset_has_plans: A scheduled contribution buys this asset: stop the contribution first, or keep the asset.
asset_exists: This name is taken, or you already hold this instrument under another name.
levy_has_no_settlement_category: This rule does not say where its payments are filed: give it a settlement category in Settings.
levy_due_not_found: This due date no longer exists for this rule: the schedule has changed since it was displayed.
levy_files_no_return: This due date has no return to file: there is nothing to file as a nil return.
levy_period_running: This period is not over: it is filed once it closes.
levy_amount_unknown: The amount of this due date depends on an input never entered: fill it in under Settings rather than filing a nil return.
levy_due_not_nil: This period has receipts, so it is not a nil return: check the date or the activity of the movements.
nil_return_not_found: This due date has no nil return to withdraw.
levy_validity: The end of validity falls before the start.
levy_form_needs_param: This amount form needs its parameter.
levy_form_param_unexpected: A parameter of another amount form was sent.
levy_value_invalid: An entered value is out of bounds.
levy_base_needs_levy: This measure reads another rule: say which one.
levy_base_needs_input: This measure reads an input: enter its name.
levy_base_levy_unexpected: This measure reads no other rule.
base_levy_other_activity: A rule only reads the rules of its own activity.
base_levy_not_found: The rule it reads no longer exists.
levy_referenced: Another rule reads this one: edit that rule first, or close this one.
levy_settlement_category_taken: Another rule of this activity already settles in this category over the same period: each would count the other’s payments. Give it its own category.
levy_has_settlements: A payment has already been declared in its category: this rule is part of the history. Close it.
supersede_before_start: The replacement starts after the current rule began.
modifier_value_invalid: The modifier’s value is out of bounds.
modifier_single_duration: A modifier has a single duration: months, periods or end date.
input_value_invalid: This input needs a name and a value.
threshold_value_invalid: A threshold needs a label, a value, and what changes beyond it.
bad_amount: The amount must be greater than zero.
due_before_issue: The due date cannot come before the issue date.
withholding_exceeds_total: Withholding cannot exceed the total due (excl. VAT + VAT).
invoice_reference_taken: An invoice of this activity already has this reference.
invoice_needs_income: Only income can pay an invoice.
invoice_other_client: An invoice is paid by the client it was issued to.
invoice_other_activity: The income that pays an invoice belongs to the invoice’s activity.
invoice_cancelled: This invoice is canceled: nothing is owed on it anymore.
invoice_currency_mismatch: The income is declared in the invoice’s currency.
invoice_overpaid: This amount exceeds what is left to collect on the invoice.
invoice_settled: This invoice is already fully collected.
invoice_has_payments: Income already pays this invoice: detach it first.
invoice_below_payments: The net receivable cannot drop below what has already been collected.
invoice_not_open: This invoice is collected or canceled: nothing to send a reminder for.
